summary: Rules lead rulings on #354: actions that move Personalities to a battle are Absent Battle actions for either player (MovesToBattle flag derived from the effect cases, scan-tested; hand-kept id list removed; Earth Flows Defender-only, Munefusa explicit Absent); Reactions no longer end an Additional Action burst, after-action windows return to the burst holder, a negated additional action leaves the rest of the burst. Shared because the engine changes legal actions (rules) and the decision docs and tests span lanes; no client or view contract change.
